subject: Game Theory
title: Liquid Democracy
description: A fast breakdown of Liquid Democracy for builders.

hook.text: You know nothing about energy policy but your friend is an expert. What if you could delegate your vote to her?

buildup.text: Liquid democracy lets voters either vote directly or delegate their vote to a trusted proxy on each issue.

discovery.text: Proxies can delegate further, creating chains. An energy expert might accumulate thousands of delegated votes.

twist.text: The risk: delegation chains concentrate power. A few super-delegates could control most votes on popular topics.

climax.text: Germany's Pirate Party tested liquid democracy. It improved participation but struggled with power concentration.

punchline.text: Delegate your vote, not your judgment.

quiz.question: What is the main risk of liquid democracy?
options: Power concentrates in a few super-delegates
